title: EvalRunnerFailed payload
description: The runner could not answer a case: the model call failed, timed out, answered no valid answer or found the budget or the instance's daily ceiling spent; no `cortex ask serve` answered at the address the spec's `ask.listen` names, the spec has no `ask` section, or the service answered `model-failed`, `reader-failed` or a refusal of the request itself (`unidentified`, `bad-request`, or `rate-limit` and `busy` still after its retries); or the run `replay` names holds no recorded answer for a case. `results.jsonl` keeps the results of the cases answered before; no `summary.json` was written.
